jobs.description_text: About the Customer Success team: Customer Success is dedicated to enabling our customers to get the most out of the automation we deploy, facilitating a superb experience through all facets of our relationship. As Customer Success Manager , you will serve as the primary point of contact and advisory partner for our customers: visiting and consulting with those customers in the field, and driving solutions across various groups within Formic for optimal delivery of technical, operational, training and administrative support for our industrial robot systems. jobs.title: Head of Marketing - Bolingbrook, IL
jobs.description_text: About the team: Formic's Marketing Team is the growth engine behind our commercial expansion. We move fast, experiment boldly, and build systems that scale. We work in close lockstep with Sales, RevOps, and Leadership to generate pipeline, sharpen our message, and get in front of the right manufacturers at the right time. This team is small, high-impact, and driven - and we're looking for someone who can match that energy. About this role: As our Head of Marketing, you will build, optimize, and lead a scalable engine for creating demand and qualified pipeline. You will own how Formic shows up in the market, how we identify and reach the manufacturers we can help, and how we turn that engagement into high quality opportunities for Sales. This is a broad, hands-on role spanning Marketing, lead generation, Sales Development, and GTM Engineering and managing a team to deliver across those areas. You'll bring those capabilities together around a common goal: creating qualified pipeline and quantifying through data and insights what's driving it. As Formic grows, you'll help determine how the team and these capabilities evolve. We're looking for someone who combines creativity with operating rigor. You'll set strategy, but you'll stay close enough to the work to understand what's actually happening. You'll establish clear priorities, ownership, and metrics, and make decisions based on results. When something works, you'll scale it. When it doesn't, you'll change it or stop doing it

jobs.title: IT Systems & Automation Lead - Bolingbrook
jobs.description_text: About the Role We're looking for an AI-native, technically resourceful operator to rethink how IT works at Formic. You'll own the day-to-day technology experience for Formicans, from devices, applications, and employee support to infrastructure, security fundamentals, and external technology partners. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with significant autonomy: you'll solve immediate problems while building smarter, more reliable systems that prevent them from recurring. If the Wi-Fi is down, someone's account isn't working, a conference room isn't connecting, a new hire needs a laptop, or a critical application goes offline, you're the person who makes sure it gets handled. You aren't expected to personally pull every cable, configure every system, or solve every specialized security issue. You are expected to own the outcome. You don't need to know every system we use on Day 1. We'd rather hire someone with strong technical fundamentals, exceptional resourcefulness, and an ability to learn quickly. Over time, we expect you to become an expert in Formic's technology environment and help shape how our systems evolve as we grow. You do need to be highly capable at using AI to extend what you can do. We want someone who is genuinely excited about technology and constantly asks: Why are we doing this manually? jobs.title: Temp Color Assistant
jobs.description_text: OVERVIEW Alo is seeking a detail-oriented Freelance Color Assistant to support our Raw Materials team for a 3 month assignment. This role is fully onsite and is ideal for someone who enjoys organization, precision, and working with product development teams in a fast-paced environment. RESPONSIBILITIES Sample & Mail Intake : Receive all color-related mail and packages, verify contents, log items into tracking tools, and ensure timely distribution to the appropriate team members. Color File Management : Organize and maintain physical and digital color files to support efficient review and decision-making by the Raw Materials and Product teams. Record Keeping : Update internal systems with accurate color data, approvals, and comments; create and update folders for new submissions and archive completed work. Color Continuity Support : Help maintain seasonal color continuity tools/cards, ensuring consistency across styles, seasons, and collections. Cross-Functional Coordination : Assist in preparing, routing, and tracking color submissions and lab dips for internal stakeholders and external partners. Tracking & Reporting : Log submissions in and out as they move between teams, keeping timelines and status reports up to date. QUALIFICATIONS Strong sense of ownership with excellent attention to detail and accuracy. Flexible, positive attitude with a willingness to support shifting priorities. Highly organized, able to handle multiple tasks and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

The Visual Lead will work closely with Operations & Visual Managers in initiating, delegating work, and providing feedback to the team to achieve optimal results supporting total store operations. jobs.description_text: The Medical Imaging Case Analyst is responsible for creating computer 3D models of coronary arteries from cardiac medical imaging (CT scans). These 3D coronary artery models show how narrowings and blockages impact blood flow. Creation of the model is done through the use of Heartflow developed software and processes. In this role, you will work within an operations team to process individual models on a recurring basis. A variety of backgrounds, including but not limited to: radiology, medical technicians, biological sciences, 3D animation, and/or CAD/visual inspection may qualify for this position. Due to the unique skills needed, employees will be trained on the specific software tools, CT image visualization process, and technology used/developed by Heartflow. The work we do supports hospitals, physicians, and emergency room patients in countries around the world. This position requires flexibility of work hours and a willingness to work non-traditional hours, including some holidays and weekends. This is a full-time, hourly compensated position. Job Responsibilities: Interpret CT imaging data, per regulated process, to generate custom 3D computer models that are used for fluid dynamic simulations and sent to the customer for interpretation of patient outcome. Perform in-process visual inspections and verifications on image data quality and models while maintaining high levels of quality and efficiency. jobs.description_text: 1891 Signal Integrity Measurement Engineer Location: Austin About the Role Validate signal integrity (SI) and power integrity (PI) for advanced compute platforms, focusing on hands-on measurement, electrical compliance, troubleshooting, and simulation correlation. Key Responsibilities Develop measurement plans and design of experiments (DOE) for board-to-board, cable, backplane, blade-, and rack-level interconnects. Measure scattering parameters (S-parameters), insertion loss, return loss, impedance, crosstalk, eye diagrams, jitter, timing margins, and bit error rates. Design printed circuit board (PCB) test fixtures; perform calibration, de-embedding, and electrical compliance testing against interface specifications and customer requirements. Correlate measurements with simulations and troubleshoot issues with silicon, package, board, and system teams, interconnect vendors, and original design manufacturers (ODMs). Prepare validation and compliance reports covering methods, pass/fail results, performance margins, findings, and recommendations. Required Qualifications Hands-on expertise with vector network analyzers (VNAs), including performance network analyzers (PNAs); time-domain reflectometers (TDRs); bit error rate testers (BERTs); and high-speed oscilloscopes. Strong SI/PI fundamentals and experience with fixture characterization, repeatable measurements, DOE, and electrical compliance testing.
